company.name: 环球优选（示例公司名，请替换）
company.factory_area: 6,000㎡ 自有工厂 + 12 家合作产线
about: 环球优选是一家面向跨境卖家的供应链与培训服务公司，主营消费电子、家居用品、美妆个护、灯具照明、汽配五金等类目。我们深耕中国华南产业带，与 12 家品类工厂建立稳定合作，为 Amazon、TikTok Shop、Shopee、Lazada、独立站等渠道的卖家提供选品、OEM/ODM 定制、质检与出口一站式服务。
公司坚持「先算清账、再做生意」的服务理念：为每个合作客户提供目的国合规与税务提示（详见本页下方）、阶梯报价与利润测算协助，帮助卖家在合规前提下把产品卖得明白、赚得踏实。
同时，我们运营跨境电商培训中心，涵盖平台运营、物流合规、广告投放等实战课程，并配套在线测验体系，帮助团队与新客户快速建立系统认知。
about_en: GlobalPick is a sourcing & training company for cross-border sellers, covering consumer electronics, home goods, beauty & personal care, lighting and auto accessories. Based in South China's industrial belt, we work with 12 partner factories to provide one-stop sourcing, OEM/ODM customization, QC and export services for sellers on Amazon, TikTok Shop, Shopee, Lazada and independent stores.
We believe in "do the math first, then do the business": every client receives destination-country compliance & tax notes (see the table below), tiered pricing and profit-calculation support.
We also run a cross-border e-commerce training center with practical courses on platform operations, logistics compliance and advertising, plus an online quiz system.

compliance.note: ≤500 令吉低价值进口商品按 10% 征税，由平台/注册卖家代收代缴，定价须含税测算。
compliance.note_en: Low-value goods ≤RM500 are taxed at 10%, collected by platforms/registered sellers. Include it in pricing.

compliance.rule: 进口最低门槛 100 美元
compliance.note: 部分品类设 100 美元/件最低进口门槛，低于门槛商品须符合正面清单与合规渠道要求。
compliance.note_en: Certain categories require a USD 100 minimum per item; below-floor items must comply with the positive list.

compliance.rule: 2025 起取消跨境小包 VAT 免税
compliance.note: 跨境小额包裹不再免征增值税，按标准 VAT 征收，直邮与平台模式均受影响。
compliance.note_en: Cross-border small parcels no longer VAT-exempt; standard VAT applies to both direct-mail and platform models.

compliance.note: 进口低价值商品（≤400 新币）GST 9%，由注册的海外卖家或平台代收代缴。
compliance.note_en: GST 9% applies to low-value imports (≤SGD 400), collected by registered overseas vendors or platforms.

compliance.note: 数字平台须代扣代缴 12% VAT，卖家报价需将代扣税负计入成本。
compliance.note_en: Digital platforms must withhold & remit 12% VAT — include it in your cost model.
